preconditions.description: The number of remaining boxes must be between 0 and 4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 500 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each remaining box must contain between 1 and 500 candies.
The length of the list of remaining boxes must match the number of remaining boxes n.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' if a solution exists or 'NO' if it does not.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and len(b) == 4 - n and all(1 <= b_i <= 10**6 for b_i in b)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output must include 4 - n integers, each between 1 and 1,000,000.
If a solution exists, the arithmetic mean, median, and range of the complete set of boxes must be equal.
